$comment: APPROVED-COMPONENT REGISTRY. This file records what composable components, blocks, features, and shared patterns exist; src/component-registry.test.ts enforces bidirectional existence and feature import discipline. Visual meaning comes from docs/reference/design-system.md. A registry entry does not make a shipped R5 composition permanent: D6 may cull, merge, or retire entries, and deletion must remove the corresponding file/feature in the same implementation pass.

Block.role: Section dispatcher — routes one guide section to its blocks/ renderer

Contours.role: Shared decorative contour ground; D6 reviews where cartographic ornament remains appropriate

GapBlock.role: Honest-absence marker — renders a known gap loud, never filler

Hint.role: '?' affordance holding an explanation until asked

PaintedAtlas.role: Current generated destination cover/identity surface; ambient/living behavior is under D6 review

Panel.role: Current bounded content/tool container; universal-panel usage and reorder behavior are under D6 review

ProvenancePopover.role: Provenance dot + evidence popover (the notation layer)

PwaHead.role: Shared head bits: offline/installable + app icons

ReminderRow.role: One reminder line (print duplicates it outside the panel)

ToolsScreen.role: Current aggregate tools station; final traveler navigation placement is under D6 review

TransitLinks.role: 'Get me there' — one-tap deep links to a verified coordinate

RoutesBlock.role: Transit legs as a journey line

field-tools.role: In-field tools (SOS, address card, focus today)

guide-rail.role: Current guide content-group rail; final navigation architecture is under D6 review

itinerary.role: Itinerary interactions including current story mode; story mode is under D6 review

mobile-nav.role: Current bottom navigation/sheet implementation; adaptive ranking and final architecture are under D6 review

palette.role: Current command palette; relationship to traveler-facing global Search is under D6 review

panel.role: Current panel collapse/reorder behavior; reorder is under D6 review

trip-tools.role: Current tools aggregation model; generic Tools/More is not assumed as final navigation

pill.contract: Pressable-control pattern. Current implementation is predominantly pill-shaped; final geometry is a D6 decision. Important field controls retain the ~44px target floor and token colors.

card.contract: Bounded content/evidence container pattern. Cards are not the universal page canvas; final geometry/radius roles are a D6 decision.

overlay.contract: Full-screen scrims/sheets: rgba(var(--shadow-rgb),alpha) ground; roles today: modal backdrop (~.45), bottom sheet (.6-.75), photo lightbox (.92)
overlay.note: z-index values predate the --z-* scale; retrofit is tracked in base.css's M3 note. Scrim-alpha role tokens are a D6 punch-list candidate.
